title: initiateMigration relinquishes the swept set-aside buffer instead of realising it; the safety of that choice is imported from an unasserted sibling-repo property and documented nowhere
description: D3 relinquishes `booked` with no realisation attempt and no comment explaining why that is safe, so the capital never reaches the balance D4 (`R = balanceOf(this)`) is about to measure.
impact: None demonstrated against deployed code. The originally-claimed 45,000 USDC of stranded value is WITHDRAWN as INVALID: it was an artifact of MockYieldStrategy.withdraw's uncapped proportional payout. Both concretes at lib/reflax-yield-vault HEAD 0110ce4 compute vault.convertToShares(amount) and cap to the strategy share balance, so the buffer already softens the migration through the strategy leg (Tier-3 EXHIBIT A: R = 945,000, residue 0.000000; EXHIBIT C reproduces R = 900,000 on the mock only).

severityMoved.reason: Refuted on deterministic Tier-3 exhibits A/C; a finding that reproduces only on a mock is not a finding.

recommendation: Do NOT adopt the original 'withdraw booked before relinquishing' mitigation: on a single-client strategy it is a no-op (INV-1) and on a multi-client one it is a transfer from sibling clients (T3-03). Document at the call site that the safety of the relinquish depends on AYieldStrategy._disposeShares' convertToShares-then-cap prologue.
watchNote: EXPIRY CONDITIONS, do not delete this entry. CORRECTED 2026-08-29: this note previously read "the harm scenario returns if (a) T3-03's global share cap is narrowed to per-client". That is INVERTED. T3-03 is now CLOSED BY THE OWNER AS INTENDED DESIGN: the other clients on those vaults are phUSD minters that mint without redeeming, so the global cap IS a deliberate cushion for stable-staker's par exits. Narrowing it to per-client would BREAK the intended cushion, not fix a defect, and must never be recommended. LIVE EXPIRY CONDITIONS: (a) a new concrete IYieldStrategy lands with a different write-down rule (INV-2); (b) a redemption-capable (non-minter) client is authorized alongside stable-staker on a shared vault position, which voids T3-03's closure. INV-1 must be re-run before this closure is carried forward, and before any change to _disposeShares' cap semantics -- as a departure from intended design, not as a fix.
